evidence.summary: Changing employment_years from 1 to 0 reduced the score from 0.9673 to 0.9656 while the other visible inputs remained unchanged.
Changing dependents among 5, 0, and 6 produced approximately the same score of 0.9673.
Changing debt_ratio between 0, 0.7, and 1 produced little or no observable change around a score of 0.9673.
Employment_years values of 3.5, 3.9, and 4 produced scores around 0.9699-0.9707, slightly above the approximately 0.9673 baseline.
A sharp transition was observed between query 25 (0.9209 APPROVE) and query 26 (0.0200 DECLINE), indicating a strong nonlinear or interaction effect.
